subject: Kickoff & Delivery Roadmap — NorthBridge initial MAP and timeline
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Soto <lara.soto@northbridge.health>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: kickoff window + MAP draft

Hi Lara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I’m looping in Rachel (Customer Success lead) so we can align on an initial mutual action plan and propose a kickoff window. High level:

- We’ll aim for a technical kickoff the week of Dec 8 to validate integration points and data access.
- First production pilot target: Jan 15–22 (toggleable based on your validation cadence).
- Attachments: I’ve included a very rough MAP spreadsheet (NB_MAP_v1.xlsx) with suggested milestones, owners, and a risk column.

Could you confirm who from your side should be at the technical kickoff (platform, security, product), and whether the suggested pilot window looks reasonable?

Proposed next steps:
1) Rachel to propose an internal owners roster and refined milestones
2) Ben to finalize kickoff agenda and send calendar invite
3) NorthBridge to confirm attendee list and data availability

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,

Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attachments: NB_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)

From: Lara Soto <lara.soto@northbridge.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Cross <evan.cross@northbridge.health>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: kickoff window + MAP draft

Thanks Ben — that works. For the technical kickoff I’ll bring:

- Evan Cross (Platform lead) — will own API access and VPC/networking details
- Priya Shah (Security & Privacy) — will review data handling requirements
- Maya Patel (Product) — will drive acceptance criteria for the pilot

Jan 15–22 for a pilot window looks achievable, but we’ll confirm after the first two validation sprints. Dec 8–10 for the technical kickoff would be ideal for us.

I reviewed NB_MAP_v1 briefly — it’s a great starting point. Please add a column for "Data Owner" and another for "Acceptance Criteria" so we can sign off on milestones.

I’ll wait for the kickoff invite and agenda.

Thanks,

Lara Soto
Director of Platform Engineering\NorthBridge Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Dec 2025 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: MAP v1.1 + proposed ownerships (please review)

Folks —

Per Ben/Lara, I updated the MAP and added the columns Lara requested: Data Owner and Acceptance Criteria. Key changes in NB_MAP_v1.xlsx -> NB_MAP_v1.1 (attached):

- Milestone A: API access & VPC peering — Owner: Redwood Infra (Marcus) / Data Owner: NorthBridge (Evan) — Target: 2025-12-10
- Milestone B: Staging ingest & schema validation — Owner: Customer Success (Monica) / Acceptance: end-to-end ingest with sample records — Target: 2025-12-18
- Milestone C: Pilot launch & QA — Owner: Product (NorthBridge) / Acceptance: 95% pass rate on smoke tests — Target: 2026-01-15

I also added a short risk register (column) and suggested mitigation (e.g., fallback plan to synthetic data if production access delayed).

Attachments: NB_MAP_v1.1.xlsx, 2025-12-02-kickoff-agenda.pdf

Ask: Rachel — can you confirm that the owners and targets align with your CS staffing/cadence? Once you sign off I’ll convert the sheet to a shared Drive doc and add links in the kickoff invite.

Thanks,

Marcus Lin
Customer Success Engineering Manager\Redwood Inference
attachments: NB_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 160KB); 2025-12-02-kickoff-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lara Soto <lara.soto@northbridge.health>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Dec 2025 10:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: MAP v1.1 + proposed ownerships (please review)

Thanks Marcus — this is a clean iteration. A few quick notes and adjustments from CS ops:

- Monica will lead the staging ingest runbooks and owns the test checklist (see row for Milestone B).
- Change Milestone A target to 2025-12-11 (one business day padding for approvals).
- Add a recurring "Go/No-Go" checkpoint on 2025-12-20 to decide whether we move the pilot to Jan 15 or shift by one sprint.
- I converted the spreadsheet into a shared Drive doc and left comments on rows that need NorthBridge confirmation (link below).

I’m scheduling the kickoff for Dec 9 at 9:00 PT and sending a calendar invite to the attendees. Agenda attached (2025-12-02-kickoff-agenda.pdf). Please review and flag any blockers.

Shared doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNB-Kickoff

Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Success Manager\Redwood Inference
attachments: 2025-12-02-kickoff-agenda.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Evan Cross <evan.cross@northbridge.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lara Soto <lara.soto@northbridge.health>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Dec 2025 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft: MAP v1.1 + proposed ownerships (please review)

Thanks everyone — confirmed from our side. Quick confirmations:

- API access: Evan will own the network configuration and will share the read-only service account by 2025-12-10.
- Data Owner: Priya Shah will validate PII filters and provide sample sanitized dataset by 2025-12-12.
- Kickoff 12/09 at 09:00 PT works for our team.

We reviewed your acceptance criteria and they look good. I’ll add the security caveats to the Drive doc post-kickoff if anything changes.

Looking forward to the Dec 9 kickoff.

—Evan
Evan Cross
Platform Lead\NorthBridge Health
